C9000056.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 056 (Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs.; papers: Termination of generalized log canonical flips on compact Kähler fourfolds; Termination of generalized-canonical flips on compact Kähler fourfolds; Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary; Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds; Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

CP_BOUND.statement: For the specified projective resolution of an ordinary terminal compact Kahler fourfold, b_T is at most the number of distinct global exceptional primes over T of ordinary log discrepancy two.

CP_LINK.statement: Canonical resolution-to-punctured-neighborhood restriction is a monodromy-equivariant surjection W->V; only a local analytic decomposition theorem is needed.

CP_MONODROMY.statement: The projective scheme-fiber Picard and countable Quot argument gives finite monodromy of W and b_T independent invariant lifts to W.

CP_COMPACT.statement: The Runge loop-carrying compact has the required Stein neighborhood and Fujino full-compact small factorialization; the prescribed Weil divisors have one common Cartier multiple before restriction.

CP_DEGREE.statement: The degree map on all normalized surface families is injective, including all cover sheets and the topology of nonreduced one-dimensional fibers; hence b_T<=s.

CP_GLOBAL.statement: Over a curve domain surjecting on the full curve fundamental group, restriction is a bijection of local and global ordinary-log-discrepancy-two places centered on the domain and the curve; every such place is on the fixed principalizing resolution.

CP_COMPLEX_EXTENSION.statement: The same curve bound and core-globalization bijection hold for compact normal complex fourfolds without a Kahler hypothesis, retaining the specified projective resolution and all remaining assumptions.

CP_BRANCH_IMPACT.statement: Conditional on the separate Section 05 topological estimate and Section 07 local weight bounds, the verified curve bound supplies the singular-curve contribution to the branch inequality and nonnegative junction difficulty. The separate antecedents are not certified here.
